findings.description: The bucket has no ACL set to private (comment indicates it is public), lacks server-side encryption, versioning, and access logging, exposing potentially sensitive data to unauthenticated access and leaving it unprotected against tampering or accidental deletion.

findings.issue_category: sensitive data stored in public/unencrypted bucket
findings.description: A customer master data file (customer-master.xlsx) is uploaded to the aws_s3_bucket.data bucket, which is public and unencrypted, exposing sensitive customer data to unauthorized access.
The bucket does not define a server_side_encryption_configuration block, so sensitive financial data is stored unencrypted at rest, increasing exposure risk if underlying storage is compromised.
The bucket lacks a server_side_encryption_configuration block, meaning operational data is stored without encryption at rest.
The bucket does not configure server_side_encryption_configuration, leaving data science data unencrypted at rest despite having versioning and logging enabled.
